new_result.statement: If an ORIGINAL-coordinate invertible indefinite physical pair D has Schur complement S containing an ORIGINAL-coordinate invertible indefinite 2x2 principal block E, then arbitrary independent cap-one inputs satisfy ||p_Q||inf <= C Delta^(-1/5) kappa^(-3/10)(delta nu)^(-1/10), C=5*2^(11/5)*3^(-3/5)=11.884016386440024, where Delta=|det D|, kappa=sigma_min(D), delta=|det E|, nu=sigma_min(E). The fixed-instance C0 representative has the same height after the interval bound is paid.
new_result.log_potential_lemma: For an affine indefinite pair R with matrix E, sup_t E log_+(L/|R-t|) <= 8sqrt(2)L^(3/4)(|det E|sigma_min(E))^(-1/4).
new_result.exact_target_family: Q_theta=4XY+U^2+2UV+theta V^2. For 0<theta<=1/2 the new theorem gives a C0 density and uniform height <8.903. At theta=0 the designated account02/B15 partner theorem gives height <=2+2log2 and majority-sheet coefficient <=pi.

absolute_continuity: For any nonzero symmetric A and any absolutely continuous joint input law, X^TAX is absolutely continuous qualitatively; no rank-three or density-cap condition is needed and no quantitative height follows.

regularity_ledger.same_constant_c0_compiler: For fixed rank>=3 cap-one product instances, separately proved interval domination P(Q in I)<=M|I| upgrades to p_Q in C0 with the same M.

partner.application: Applied to Q_0=4XY+U^2+2UV to obtain ||p_Q0||inf<=2+2log2 and Pr{Q0 in I,Q0>=-V^2}<=pi|I|; then used as the endpoint of the new both-nonzero-diagonal target collar.
